description: Set what one of the brand's numbers does. connectInbox:true brings its texts into the Hermoso Inbox (false stops it). forwardTo sends its calls to a phone number (+1…), a voice agent's SIP address (sip:…, e.g. a Vapi, Retell or ElevenLabs agent) or, on Twilio, a wss:// media stream; empty string stops forwarding. record:true records forwarded calls. missedCallText is a text sent back to a caller whose call was not answered (empty string turns it off). tracking { campaign, platform, campaignId, callValue } tags the number with the ad campaign it is printed in, for call_tracking_report. If the number's texts or calls already go somewhere else, the answer names it and replaceExisting:true takes them over. Free. Needs Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).

number.description: the number or its id from list_phone_numbers
